description: A sponsor (an account with a linked Solana wallet: one made by Sign in with Solana has its own) proposes a competition scored by a house template and funds its placement prizes from that wallet; the deposit sits in the on-chain escrow from the moment it is signed until the house approves it (the escrow opens and the competition is listed) or returns it (rejected with a reason and a fix for each check it failed, withdrawn by the sponsor, or expired past the review deadline, when anyone may return it). A proposal made from a suggestion's option that proposal_suggestion marks auto_list, changed only in what its amendable fields allow, is listed the moment its deposit lands, with no review, opening on the first whole hour at least sponsor_terms' limits.auto_list_lead_minutes on (proposal_status says auto_list). A judged text, image or code bounty from an option whose setup is self is prepared by make.fun after funding and then lists with no review, opening limits.self_setup_lead_minutes on (proposal_status says self_setup while it is prepared). Every other proposal is reviewed by make.fun before it is listed, its entries opening after the review hours. This is what a sponsor accepts before a deposit: the sponsor terms in force (their version, which proposal_deposit's terms_version names to accept them; their status, a draft until counsel signs off; every clause), the sha256 of their canonical JSON (keep it to prove the text you accepted), this server's limits (the prize pool's floor and ceiling in USD, min_prize_usd and max_prize_usd: the floor is $1 at the least on every server, the ceiling null for none; the floor is $5 unless this server sets its own; min_pot_fee_multiple, how many times its entry fee (entry_fee_usd) the pool totals at the least (5 by default; 0: no such rule); min_entry_fee_usd, the least entry fee in USD a proposal names ($0.10 by default; 0: no such rule, any fee above $0), while no entry fee, free entry, is always allowed; a Cheapest to build bounty's build allowance floor and ceiling in USD, min_allowance_usd and max_allowance_usd, null for no bound on that side, and how much of it each entrant's build keys spend by default, build_key_per_entrant_usd, and allowance_closed, why this server takes no build allowance now (null while it takes one), so it funds no Cheapest to build bounty; the creator share of entry fees: min_creator_percent and max_creator_percent, the least and the most of each fee a proposal's creator_percent may keep (max 0: none offered), creator_cut_percent, published under fee_model beside alone, make.fun's cut of that share in percent of it, paid to the make.fun fund and fixed in a bounty's rules when it is composed (under total the cut follows from the share, the least that makes fee_house_percent), creator_payout, where the creator's share of a bounty funded now goes (balance: added to the creator's make.fun balance, which they claim like other rewards; wallet: paid on chain to the funding wallet as each fee is paid), and creator_share_closed, why this server takes no creator share now (null while it takes one); make.fun's house share of every entry fee: fee_house_percent, the percent of each fee (15 at the least, the fund floor) paid to the make.fun fund, and fee_model, how it is taken: total (the default), that percent of each fee in total, out of the creator's share when the creator keeps one (a creator_percent is at least it), or beside, that percent of every fee whether or not the creator keeps a share (a creator_percent is at most 100 less it), and while no creator share is taken (creator_share_closed set, or max_creator_percent 0) the rest of each fee joins the reward pool (fixed in a bounty's rules when it is composed), and entry_fee_closed, why this server takes no entry fee now (null while it takes them); the review hours after which make.fun opens entries at the soonest, max_start_hours, the latest opening a sponsor may choose as competition.start_at (a UTC instant from that soonest opening to the first whole hour at least this many hours after the checks; 24 by default; null: this server offers no chosen start, so make.fun picks the opening and refuses any start_at), auto_list_lead_minutes and self_setup_lead_minutes, how soon after its checks a bounty made from a suggestion's option that lists with no review opens (the short lead, and for a judged text or picture make.fun prepares by itself once funded, that lead plus its setup time, text and image, null for a medium it does not prepare here, and code, for a code bounty whose hidden tests make.fun writes and checks by itself once funded, present only where this server lists one so; null while listing with no review is off here), min_entries_hours, the shortest time entries stay open (15 minutes on the house's schedule, any length past it as long as the whole run leaves, as competition.duration_hours names it), max_run_hours, the longest whole run from the opening to the end of the final, entries and the final after them together (168 hours, a week, by default; shorter runs are better), ready_templates, each ready template's finals (harness.dataset: how long each runs after entries close and max_duration_hours, the most duration_hours it leaves, null when none) and whether it is offered here at all (offered: false when no final of it leaves an entries window), max_open and max_per_day, proposals in review or running at once (a funded bounty runs until its result is posted or it is cancelled) and submitted per day, the escrow's mint and cluster), whether the desk takes deposits now (intake_open), make.fun's bounty match as this caller could get it now (match: percent, the share of a reward pool make.fun matches, and max_usd, the most it adds to one bounty, so a pool P is matched min(P * percent / 100, max_usd); null while the promo is off or spent; make.fun pays the match to the winners at the result, and it is never part of the deposit or held in the escrow), and the suggest service (suggest: enabled, whether proposal_suggest answers here, and max_prompt_chars, the longest prompt it takes). Anyone may read them.
